verdict.rationale: Render's evidence describes general Docker-based web services, background workers, and static-site CDN hosting — there is no mention of an edge/serverless functions product or runtime, so there's no evidence it lets developers run unmodified Node.js/npm code in an edge/serverless function context. missing for 10: any documentation of an edge or serverless functions offering, evidence of npm package compatibility in such a runtime, comparison to restricted runtime subsets (e.g., V8 isolates).
